subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Anonymity can give people courage, but it can also reduce accountability.”?
options: Eric was new to our class.
Anna agreed, though she was disappointed.
The class discussed the digital divide.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Eric was new to our class.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Anna agreed, though she was disappointed.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The class discussed the digital divide.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Anonymity can give people courage, but it can also reduce accountability. The class agreed on rules.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Anonymity can give people courage, but it can also reduce accountability. The class agreed on rules.」，答案為「The class agreed on rules.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The class agreed on rules.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
